scope: New menus, document keys, and a media player.

topics.title: Word processor menu
details: Choose Word processor to create a document, open one, view recent files, or change its options. Open starts at the File manager drive list. Word files open for editing. Other supported files open for reading.
Press Alt in a document for its command menu. Use the usual keys to save, find, copy, paste, undo, or change text style. The menu shows the keys for each action.

topics.title: Media menu and player
details: The main menu now has Media. It holds Radio, Podcasts, and Media player.

Use Media player to open a local sound or video file. Space plays or pauses. Left and Right move back or forward 15 seconds. Up and Down change volume. You can also change speed or stop playback. Some file types may not play.

topics.title: Clear file lists and folder speech
details: Ctrl+D returns to the drive list. Ctrl+Home no longer does that. Ctrl+M no longer opens the main menu.
The drive list shows drives and cloud roots. It does not call system folders drives.
When you open a folder, you hear its name and the current item. The full path is no longer read.
